in_marathi.name: Ayushka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayushka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayushka is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ayush', meaning 'life' or 'vitality'. In Hindu mythology, Ayush is the god of longevity and good health. The name Ayushka is often given to girls born into families who value long life and good health.
